Anil Kumar Sharma — Full Stack Developer & Computer Science Student at  Nims University Rajasthan
I'm Anil Kumar Sharma, a passionate BCA student with a deep interest in Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking. I believe in understanding how systems break in order to build them better. With hands-on experience in Python, Java, C++, and modern web technologies, I bridge the gap between secure systems design and full-stack development.
